title: Witnessed drowning suicide and VA denial of his service

tellings.quote: I got out of the Air Force and I witnessed a suicide. Um dude drowned, multiple witnesses. I have the police report.

plain: A former Air Force member named Dylan Borland says that after leaving the Air Force, around 2015 in Pittsburgh, he saw a man drown himself, with several other witnesses, and that he has the police report. He tells it first-hand and also points to his enlisted performance review, the Air Force's regular rating of a service member, and to his medical records from the VA, the US Department of Veterans Affairs, which by his account denied his service. He offers the paperwork to show that his story is backed by records.
